g.title: app_lifecycle
g.text: planned → preparing → prepared → ready; applications call /v1 and never start or stop models

g.title: resolve
g.text: platform command / default bundles / pinned version

g.title: planned
g.text: written to apps.json before the install command

g.title: install_cmd
g.text: run: daemon executes the shell command
client: desktop runs it; daemon only records
URL: show the download page, never fetch

g.title: failed
g.text: install command or Prepare failed; logs kept

g.title: set_ready
g.text: set state=ready and clear error first
only then run the setup scripts
script failure writes setup_error; state stays ready

g.title: scripts
g.text: saved plan and no explicit selection → replay offline
the first failure stops the rest

g.title: ready
g.text: app configured and ready for requests
Connection only in apps.json; APIKey is always local

g.title: infer
g.text: apps have no PID / child endpoint
apps cannot start / stop / load / unload

g.title: status
g.text: reads apps.json; transitional older than ~10m → failed

g.title: uninstall
g.text: by default removes the registry entry only
shared assets kept; an uncached ref aborts purge

g.title: uninstalled
g.text: model cache / logs / setup-cache kept by default

g.title: prepare_only
g.text: may create prepared state for an uninstalled app
